description: ROS2 + DDS decomposed. Node lifecycle, executor model, topics/services/actions, QoS profiles, parameters, namespaces, launch system, DDS discovery, RMW abstraction, tf2 transforms.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_node
sub_mechanisms.definition: Process containing one or more nodes. Each node has unique name + namespace.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modular processing unit. Sensors, planners, controllers each = node. Distributed across processes + machines. Foundation of ROS2.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_executor
sub_mechanisms.definition: Manages callback execution. Single-threaded, multi-threaded, static (compile-time scheduled).
sub_mechanisms.why: Different latency + throughput characteristics. Multi-threaded: parallel callbacks. Static: deterministic for RT. Choose per requirements.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_topic_pub_sub
sub_mechanisms.definition: Asynchronous many-to-many messaging. Publishers + subscribers; topic name + message type.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard sensor data flow. Camera publishes /camera/image; many subscribers process. Decoupled. Foundation of robotic perception.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_service
sub_mechanisms.definition: Request-response RPC. Synchronous (blocking) or async client. One-shot.
sub_mechanisms.why: Commands with reply: 'compute path', 'capture image'. Distinct from topic (continuous data flow). Standard RPC for robotics.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_action
sub_mechanisms.definition: Long-running goal: goal, feedback (progress), result. Cancellation supported.
sub_mechanisms.why: 'Navigate to position': minutes-long. Action lets client monitor + cancel. Built on services + topics. Standard for plannable behaviours.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_QoS_profile
sub_mechanisms.definition: Per-topic settings. Reliability (best-effort vs reliable), durability (volatile vs transient_local), history (keep last N).
sub_mechanisms.why: Sensor stream: best-effort + small queue. Commands: reliable. Latched data: transient_local. Match QoS to data semantics.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_parameter_server
sub_mechanisms.definition: Each node has parameter dict. Settable at launch + runtime. Typed.
sub_mechanisms.why: Runtime tuning. PID gains, threshold values. Standard config mechanism. Persists via parameter YAML.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_namespace
sub_mechanisms.why: Multi-robot systems. Avoid name collisions. Remap topic names at launch. Standard scaling pattern.

sub_mechanisms.name: ROS2_launch_python
sub_mechanisms.definition: Python-based launch files. Compose nodes + parameters + conditions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Complex robotic systems. Conditional launches, parameter overrides, sub-launches. Python = full expressiveness.

sub_mechanisms.name: DDS_discovery_protocol
sub_mechanisms.definition: Nodes discover each other via multicast. SPDP for participants, SEDP for endpoints.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decentralised: no broker. Cost: multicast can't traverse subnets without help. Discovery server for cloud robotics.

sub_mechanisms.name: RMW_layer
sub_mechanisms.definition: ROS Middleware abstraction. Pluggable: Fast DDS (default), Cyclone DDS, RTI Connext.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decouples ROS2 from specific DDS. Vendor change without app rewrite. Different vendors have different strengths.

sub_mechanisms.name: tf2_transform_tree
sub_mechanisms.definition: Time-stamped coordinate frame transformations. Tree of frames; query 'pose of A in B at time T'.
sub_mechanisms.why: Robotics needs frame transforms (camera → base → world). tf2 handles. Time-aware: transforms valid at specific times.

derivation_rules.name: QoS_must_match_for_compatible_endpoints
if: publisher + subscriber QoS profiles don't match
derivation_rules.why: Reliable publisher + best-effort subscriber: OK. Best-effort publisher + reliable subscriber: incompatible. Common debugging issue.

derivation_rules.name: multi_threaded_executor_for_parallel_callbacks
derivation_rules.why: Single-threaded: serialised. Multi-threaded: parallel up to thread count. Cost: shared state needs locking. Trade-off per node.

derivation_rules.name: DDS_decentralised_discovery_scales_within_subnet
derivation_rules.why: No central broker. Multicast SPDP/SEDP. Scales well in subnet. Crosses subnets requires discovery server. Standard ROS2 model.

derivation_rules.name: actions_for_long_running_goals
derivation_rules.why: Service: blocking, no progress. Topic: no result. Action: client monitors progress + can cancel. Standard for navigation, manipulation.

derivation_rules.name: namespace_isolation_enables_multi_robot
derivation_rules.why: Each robot's nodes in own namespace. /robot1/camera, /robot2/camera. Same code different namespace = different topics. Standard multi-robot pattern.
